profile.headline: AI Systems Software Engineer at Intel
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with experience in device driver development, AI/ML model training, graphics, tooling, CI and web dev (full stack).

positions.title: AI Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
* 2026 - Led a next gen platform to 100% security certification (SDL) compliance; designed and implemented automation for SDL evidence tracking.
* 2026 - Proposed and drafted NPU extensions to the oneAPI Level Zero specification (v1.18); implemented them in the Windows Host driver.
* 2026 - Hardened the kernel mode driver against security vulnerabilities; diagnosed critical firmware crashes from kernel crash dumps.
* 2025/26 - Led the Windows Host driver for Wildcat Lake from pre-silicon bring-up through release; root-caused complex driver, compiler and firmware issues.
* 2025 - Implemented several major features of the NPU user mode driver such as compiler option queries, region memory copies and new data types.
* 2025 - Resolved high-priority crashes, BSODs and OEM escalations; contributed a fix to the open-source oneAPI Level Zero loader.
* 2024 - Led NPU driver security certification (SDL) effort for current and next gen platforms
* 2024 - Conducted candidate interviews and contributed to hiring selection process
* 2023 - Provide support of full driver stack for machine learning on Intel's dedicated neural processing engine (VPU/NPU) for current and next gen platforms.
* 2023 - Helped transition CI/CD from Jenkins to GitHub Actions and wrote new build automation workflows.
* 2022/23 - Implemented APIs for enabling hardware metrics collection for the NPU's Windows Host user mode and kernel mode drivers.
* 2022 - Presented topics in live internal/external training webcasts to improve collaboration and training between teams.
* 2021 - Automated several manual processes and improved the efficiency and robustness of Python tools for C++ header code generation.
* 2021 - Collaborated in the design, bring-up, development and testing of the oneAPI Level Zero Windows host user mode driver for current and next gen platforms.
* 2020 - Created and maintain team documentation used by multiple teams (30+ daily visits), cutting dev environment setup from one week to 4 hours.

positions.title: Founder & Product Engineer
positions.description:
Founded Platano Software to build purpose-built CRM and business automation software for event-service businesses.
Platano CRM brings inquiries, customer conversations, quoting, scheduling, payments, customer records, and AI-assisted workflows into one streamlined workspace.
I lead product strategy, software architecture, full-stack engineering, AI integrations, infrastructure, security, and user experience.
The platform grew from software built to solve real operational problems inside an active event business, with a focus on reducing administrative work and simplifying the path from inquiry to booked event.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Architecture · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software Development · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Graphics Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
* 2019 - Implemented performance update of D3D12 user mode driver by reducing number of times cache config gets set.
* 2018/19 - Prepared Jenkins test coverage, tracked passing rates, and reported results for pre-si and post-si Ice Lake and Cannon Lake hardware.
* 2018/19 - Applied bug fixes and hardware workarounds on the D3D12 user mode driver.
* 2018 - Collaborated in design ideas and implemented various internal parsing tools which automated the generation of C++ headers for the integrated graphics' unified D3D12 user mode driver.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* 2015/16 - Interpreted SRS documents and wrote coding enhancements in C#, Java & T-SQL for RSI's Revenue Premier Enterprise propietary software, providing feature and debug support across the full web stack.
* 2015 - Formulated new hire ramp up program to speed up environment set-up process by several days.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* GitHub: https://github.com/itsshortforleo
* Defined structured solutions to meet technical and operational requirements for software projects.
* Designed visual mock-ups in Adobe Photoshop prior to developing tools and web apps in Visual Studio using C# and .NET framework, and Java. 
* Designed and developed a domino board game in C# titled Domino Tropical, (Beta demo and various other app demos on YouTube: /watch?v=foyDgH7ekyg)

positions.title: IT Helpdesk Intern
positions.locationName: Santiago de los Caballeros, Dominican Republic
positions.description:
* Led team of 5+ junior peers to resolve numerous logical/physical system and networking problems.
* Implemented network design, sub-netting, Port Security for new & existing hosts, among other responsabilities.

positions.title: IT & Production Coordinator
positions.description:
* Promoted from entry level film contacting position to coordinating company’s entire workflow.
* Multi-tasked and provided on-demand service in departments of Contacting, Data Pre-Flight & Management, Output, Photoshop & Typesetting, Ad & Print Production, per departmental work density.
* Oversee customer service functions for an elite supplier of prepress.
* Provided instructions for complex retouching and critical color correction. 
* Inspected all proofs, press programs, and final films for publication or ad insertion. 
* Ensure deadlines, brand compliance and quality standards for W Magazine, BMW, Sony Music, Avon, BBDO, Deutsch, among others.
